title: 44% on ARC-AGI-1 in 67 cents
summary: A technical blog post detailing how to achieve 44% accuracy on the ARC-AGI-1 benchmark (a challenging test for measuring abstract reasoning and AGI-like capabilities) at an extremely low cost of just 67 cents, showcasing highly cost-efficient prompting or architectural techniques for LLM-based problem solving.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how to achieve competitive performance on the difficult ARC-AGI reasoning benchmark at minimal computational cost.
why_valuable: Shows that significant AI reasoning capabilities can be achieved with minimal resources, making advanced AI problem-solving more accessible and cost-effective for researchers and developers.
